detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:04. The shot begins from <Picture 2>: a medium shot inside the hansom from its near side: the two men side by side on the buttoned leather seat, Watson in the LEFT half and Holmes in the RIGHT, the folding hood closing the TOP of frame, the closed black doors across their knees and the fog-grey street beyond at the LEFT edge. The camera is on the near side of the hansom looking in across the closed black doors, level with the seated men's chests and an arm's length from their knees, a 35mm lens turned on the pair. The folding hood closes the TOP of frame. The camera pushes in a hand's breadth over the closed doors as the two men sway together a hand's breadth as the cab takes the road, from 00:00 to 00:04. Sherlock Holmes's mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:04 while he two men sway together a hand's breadth as the cab takes the road. By 00:04 the camera has finished pushing in a hand's breadth over the closed doors and stands at that distance, with the action of that shot completed.
[Shot 2] From 00:04 to 00:08. At 00:04 the shot cuts to an insert on the brass side-lamp burning at the cab's front corner, beginning from <Picture 3>: the fog-grey street sliding past beyond it, beads of wet standing on the black paint; only what <Picture 3> shows is in frame. The camera is outside the cab at the front corner, level with the lamp and a forearm's length from it, a 50mm lens turned on the burning brass. The fog-grey street slides past beyond it. At the first frame The brass side-lamp burns steadily at the cab's front corner, its flame upright behind the glass, the polished brass wet and beaded with standing drops. The black painted bodywork runs away below it, beads of wet standing along the paint. Beyond the lamp the dun-coloured fog lies over the Brixton Road and the wet cobbles carry the smeared amber of other lamps. The camera pushes in a hand's breadth on the lamp as one bead of wet runs a thumb's length down the black paint, from 00:04 to 00:08. By 00:08 the camera has finished pushing in a hand's breadth on the lamp and stands at that distance, with the action of that shot completed.
